paragraphs: R' Yannai (bar), son of R' Yannai the Elder.
Mentioned in [Megillah 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.32a.16), reporting in the name of R' Yannai Rabbah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Megillah gives Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder, reporting in Rabbi Yannai Rabbah’s name. Hyman’s heading retains the parenthetical bar.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2064&lang=en) distinguishes the Elder from Yannai Rabbah and gives the Elder as the transmitter’s grandfather, a different reading from the linked Megillah.
